scope: Source review of limn-dnd and cached native SDK ownership; no REA runtime or native DND proof

initial_read_only_finding.correction: limn-dnd exists in git source at both historical RUNE dependency revisions and inspected main; it is absent from the effective RUNE Cargo dependency graph and limn-egui integration, not absent from those git revisions.
initial_read_only_finding.implemented_mechanism: A private Wayland queue on the host window own wl_display, a wl_data_device per seat, exact wl_surface check on enter, compositor surface-local motion coordinates, and URI-list bytes received for the dropped offer. This can bypass the missing winit 0.30.13 Wayland file-event producer without a winit fork.
initial_read_only_finding.integration_status: No FileDnd caller was found outside limn-dnd itself; no limn_dnd dependency in RUNE Cargo manifests/lock. DndEvent is not automatically translated by limn-egui into UiEvent.
initial_read_only_finding.platform_limit: attach returns None outside Linux/Wayland. The lib comment about X11/Windows/macOS winit events does not establish positioned batches or verified support on those platforms.
initial_read_only_finding.test_limit: Three URI codec tests and a live connection/locally rejected outgoing-drag test exist. The live test returns early when no compositor is available; it does not exercise a real incoming batch, source-file preparation, RUNE integration or UI account/permission races.

static_findings.finding: Incoming offers advertise Copy|Move and finish before URI validation and application admission. Move completion may allow the source to delete transferred data. RUNE attachments must not acknowledge a Move operation.
static_findings.reproduction_plan: Select Move action, deliver a URI list rejected by RUNE, observe that existing Received handling still calls finish before emitting the batch. This is a source-based plan, not an executed RED.

static_findings.finding: Received carries x/y/data without offer identity; global dropped/action can be replaced by another offer/seat. Old read completion can finish/destroy the newer stored offer and emit the old batch.
static_findings.reproduction_plan: Hold read A, accept/drop B, complete A first, then B. Require matching offer, action, position and terminal for each operation; stale/cancelled results must not authorize a new UI scope.

static_findings.finding: Commands/events are unbounded, poll drains into an unbounded Vec, and each drop starts a new blocking read thread with no deadline/cancellation. take(16 MiB) truncates without detecting an extra byte or read error.
static_findings.reproduction_plan: Use a held-open URI pipe and repeated drops, then MAX_LIST_BYTES+1 input. Require one bounded reader/operation, bounded reliable terminals, coalesced hover, timeout/cancel and explicit oversized failure without prefix publication.

static_findings.finding: decode filters invalid/unsupported lines and accepts malformed percent escapes literally. Mixed lists can silently become subsets, contrary to the current RUNE all-or-error import contract.
static_findings.reproduction_plan: Valid local URI plus invalid/remote/malformed URI and oversized path/count cases; reject the full batch before any path enters Core.

static_findings.finding: Safe attach documents a borrowed window lifetime but FileDnd stores no lifetime/owner. Foreign backend requires display to remain alive; worker Drop synchronously joins, including startup roundtrip or blocking callbacks.
static_findings.reproduction_plan: Hold startup/transfer, begin host close and drop the last owner. Require explicit shutdown ownership/handshake, guest-protocol cleanup, bounded cancellation and last destructors outside UI before releasing borrowed display/surface owners.

observed: eframe 0.36.2 CreationContext supplies raw handles and Option<&Arc<winit::Window>>.
winit 0.30.13 Wayland Window owns Arc<Mutex<WindowState>> and WindowState owns a cloned wayland_client::Connection; its EventLoop separately owns Connection and event dispatch.
wayland_client 0.31.15 Connection owns Backend; system InnerBackend uses Arc<Inner>.

Backend::from_foreign_display is guest mode: it does not own/close the borrowed display and requires that display live through all guest clones; SDK requires Wayland cleanup before guest backend drop.
cached_sdk_ownership_chain.conclusion: The cached chain provides evidence for a possible retained-owner design, but obtaining or cloning Arc<Window> alone is not a complete safe-API or shutdown proof. It does not demonstrate continued event dispatch, cleanup order, worker termination or behavior after host event-loop shutdown. An explicit owner/foreign-queue shutdown handshake and lifecycle tests remain prerequisites.

proposed_next_scope.location: Separate upstream limn worktree/PR for receive-only Wayland backend hardening, then an independent limn-egui/RUNE integration slice.
prerequisites: Copy-only negotiation and exact-offer completion after validation.
Opaque per-offer/generation identity, cancel/reset of in-flight batches and stale-account/channel rejection.
Bounded queues/read credit, coalesced hover, one fixed/nonblocking read owner, explicit overflow/read failure and deadlines.
Strict complete URI-list decoding and current RUNE count/path/metadata bounds before Core admission; no automatic send.
Retain proven native owners until a tested shutdown handshake completes; no UI join or foreign-display use after owner release.
Convert surface-local coordinates to the tree coordinate/zoom space; test DPI, zoom, overlays, same-frame input and closed/changed windows.
Synthetic Wayland/state/pipe race tests followed by a real owned-fixture incoming batch and preparation QA.
proposed_next_scope.unchanged_policy: Legacy RawInput without a position tied to its batch remains rejected. This addendum does not enable imports, outgoing DND, remote uploads or another platform.
proposed_next_scope.alternatives: winit/egui 0.31 migration or a coordinated backend backport remain alternatives, not the only possible routes.
